title: Inga, Jungle Language (INJ) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map, Endangered Level & Official Use | Ethnologue Free
text: Jungle Inga is a stable indigenous language of Colombia. It belongs to the Quechuan language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
